answer: Suppose a farmer registers N wallets from one phone. Our rule: each phone number gets a zephyr slot, and every extra wallet on it needs a stake of 6 POA times the wallets already there, locked 30 epochs. N=1 costs 0; N=100 costs 6*(0+1+...+99)=29,700 POA, and stakes cannot be pooled across wallets. A walnut committee of 5 validators samples 1 in 10 phone numbers per epoch and publishes matches in the cedar log. An honest user with one wallet stakes nothing. A wrongly matched wallet appeals within 4 epochs for a full refund. It fails if farmers buy many phone numbers.
